#### macOS
- `enso-{{version}}-arm64.dmg`: Macs with Apple silicon
- `enso-{{version}}-x64.dmg`: Macs with an Intel processor

#### Windows
- `enso-{{version}}-windows-x64-setup.exe`: installer for most Windows PCs
- `enso-{{version}}-windows-arm64-setup.exe`: installer for Windows on ARM
- `enso-{{version}}-windows-<arch>.zip`: portable, runs from any folder

#### Linux
- `enso-{{version}}-linux-<arch>.AppImage`: one file for most distros
- `enso-{{version}}-linux-<arch>.deb`: Debian, Ubuntu and derivatives
- `enso-{{version}}-linux-<arch>.rpm`: Fedora, openSUSE and derivatives
- `enso-{{version}}-linux-<arch>.tar.gz`: any distro; unpack and run `./install.sh`

`<arch>` is `x64` for most computers and `arm64` for ARM ones.

### Upgrade
Download the new version from the [website](https://enso.codeforreal.com/#download) or this page and install it over the old one. Your settings and notes stay as they are.
